final: WITH side_counts AS (SELECT dealedge, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM riskandmargin r INNER JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY dealedge), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) as avg_cnt FROM side_counts), filtered_sides AS (SELECT sc.cnt, oa.avg_cnt FROM side_counts sc, overall_avg oa WHERE sc.cnt > oa.avg_cnt) SELECT SUM(cnt) as total_kept_counts, AVG(cnt - avg_cnt) as avg_difference_from_overall FROM filtered_sides
